outcomes.name: The organisational change readiness has been refined based on pilot learnings
The organisational change readiness is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Strategic Direction & Leadership to identify what needs to change in the organisational change readiness before scaling.
Refine the organisational change readiness to Strategic Direction & Leadership based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined organisational change readiness covering Strategic Direction & Leadership ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined organisational change readiness for Strategic Direction & Leadership is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the organisational change readiness for Strategic Direction & Leadership remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the organisational change readiness affected Skills & Behaviour.
Adapt the organisational change readiness relating to Skills & Behaviour for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the organisational change readiness covering Skills & Behaviour to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Skills & Behaviour among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the organisational change readiness for Skills & Behaviour.
